conbody.p: Whenever the vehicle is turned on, Lane Keeping Assist will always turn on and a gray indicator light () will appear on the cluster.
If you want to turn off Lane Keeping Assist, press and hold the Lane Driving Assist button () to turn off the function. The indicator light will turn yellow if you turn off Lane Keeping Assist.

li.p: When the operating condition of Lane Keeping Assist are met, the cluster is illuminated with a green () indicator.
When the operating conditions are not met, a gray () indicator is illuminated.

section.title: Automatic activation
section.p: Lane Keeping Assist automatically turns on when either of the following driving convenience features:

li.p: Both Lane Following Assist and Smart Cruise Control turn on

section.p: If Lane Keeping Assist has automatically turned on and the driver attempts to turn it off, a warning message appears and Lane Keeping Assist does not turn off.

If the in-cabin camera detects the driver’s drowsiness, Lane Keeping Assist activates automatically. In this case, the driver can deactivate Lane Keeping Assist by pressing and holding the Lane Driving Assist button for more than 2 seconds.

li.p: Lane Keeping Assist remains activated even if the driving convenience feature is turned off.

To deactivate Lane Keeping Assist temporarily disable Smart Cruise Control or press the Lane Driving Assist button or Driving Assist button to turn off the driving convenience feature and then attempt to deactivate it.
